query.statement: SELECT LOT_ID, MATERIAL_ID, LOT_NO, WAREHOUSE, CURRENT_QTY, UNIT, STATUS, VERSION_NO, RECEIVED_AT, EXPIRY_AT FROM IVT_MATERIAL_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@warehouse IS NULL OR WAREHOUSE = @warehouse) AND (@materialId IS NULL OR MATERIAL_ID = @materialId) ORDER BY LOT_ID

SELECT TX_ID, LOT_ID, MATERIAL_ID, TX_TYPE, QTY, FROM_WAREHOUSE, TO_WAREHOUSE, BALANCE_BEFORE, BALANCE_AFTER, BALANCE_DELTA, RESULT_STATUS, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, REQUEST_HASH, EXPECTED_VERSION, RESULT_VERSION, SOURCE_SYSTEM, SOURCE_EVENT_ID, CORRELATION_ID, METADATA_JSON, TX_AT, PROCESSED_BY, STATUS, REMARK FROM IVT_MATERIAL_TX WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@txType IS NULL OR TX_TYPE = @txType) ORDER BY TX_AT DESC, TX_ID DESC

SELECT TX_ID, LOT_ID, MATERIAL_ID, TX_TYPE, QTY, FROM_WAREHOUSE, TO_WAREHOUSE, TX_AT, PROCESSED_BY, STATUS FROM IVT_MATERIAL_TX WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TX_TYPE = 'Incoming' ORDER BY TX_AT DESC, TX_ID DESC
SELECT TX_ID, LOT_ID, MATERIAL_ID, TX_TYPE, QTY, FROM_WAREHOUSE, TO_WAREHOUSE, TX_AT, PROCESSED_BY, STATUS FROM IVT_MATERIAL_TX WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TX_TYPE = 'Move' ORDER BY TX_AT DESC, TX_ID DESC

SELECT TX_ID, LOT_ID, MATERIAL_ID, TX_TYPE, QTY, FROM_WAREHOUSE, TO_WAREHOUSE, TX_AT, PROCESSED_BY, STATUS FROM IVT_MATERIAL_TX WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TX_TYPE = 'Dispensing' ORDER BY TX_AT DESC, TX_ID DESC

SELECT CONSUMPTION_ID, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, PLANT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, MATERIAL_LOT_ID, MATERIAL_ID, PROCESS_LOT_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, PROCESS_ID, RECIPE_ID, RECIPE_VERSION, CONSUMPTION_MODE, QUANTITY, UNIT, TRACE_ID, TAG_ID, SOURCE_EVENT_ID, SOURCE_SYSTEM, OPERATOR_ID, CORRELATION_ID, WORK_SCOPE_ID, CARRIER_ID, REVERSAL_OF_ID, STATUS, OCCURRED_AT FROM IVT_MATERIAL_CONSUMPTION_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@materialLotId IS NULL OR MATERIAL_LOT_ID = @materialLotId) AND (@processLotId IS NULL OR PROCESS_LOT_ID = @processLotId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@workScopeId IS NULL OR WORK_SCOPE_ID = @workScopeId) AND (@carrierId IS NULL OR CARRIER_ID = @carrierId) AND (@from IS NULL OR OCCURRED_AT >= @from) AND (@to IS NULL OR OCCURRED_AT < @to) ORDER BY OCCURRED_AT DESC, CONSUMPTION_ID DESC
